intent: Floating glass tab bar for a monochrome running app: outline-to-filled icon morphs, a selection lens that stretches toward where it's going, rolling badges and a raised accent action with an arc of quick actions; every tab is a finished screen whose blocks blur in, numbers count up and charts draw on each visit.

stack.web: react-native-web compatible; keep opacity animations off the BlurView's ancestors

layout.stage: #0A0A0A with a 6% white radial glow top right; ScrollView with 58pt top, 16pt sides, 12pt gaps, 150pt bottom padding so it scrolls under the bar
layout.bar: absolute, 14pt sides, 26pt bottom, 68pt tall, radius 34; five equal slots, the middle one reserved
layout.arcMenu: three 58pt items on a 118pt radius at 150°, 90°, 30° with labels below
layout.toast: glass pill 16pt from sides, 52pt from top

screens.today: greeting + avatar; hero card with 32.4 km of 40, 92pt ring, seven day bars; pace tile with sparkline; 12-day streak meter of 14 bars; last-run card with four stats and a drawn street map; up-next card with stacked avatars
screens.routes: featured map card (one marker where the loop closes) with three stats; four saved routes with drawn thumbnails and elevation sparklines (52pt wide under 380pt, 76pt above)
screens.club: club goal 1,846/2,500 km with a 6pt bar; kudos card with stacked greyscale avatars (20% overlap, ringed in the card colour); five-row leaderboard with thin bars, your row lifted 5%
screens.you: 84pt avatar with an accent year-goal ring and 86% pill; three-up year stats; four personal-best tiles; shoe mileage with an 8pt bar

color.approach: monochrome first: one neutral family plus a single accent prop; no decorative colour
color.accent: #FF6B3D (prop `accent`): centre action, selected tab icon, week ring, today's bar, You ring; nowhere else
color.data: routes, sparklines, streak and progress bars in white and greys
color.avatars: greyscale gradients; yours inverted (white disc, black initials)
color.glass: BlurView 100 dark + white sheen 12%→2% + 4pt dot dither + hairline 26% top / 10% sides / 5% bottom

motion.lens: left and right edges spring separately: leading 520/46, trailing 210/29 (both critically damped); scaleY 1→0.86 while stretched
motion.iconMorph: outline fades and shrinks to 0.78; filled grows from 0.55 on spring 360/18 (one overshoot); deselect 500/44
motion.centrePress: translateY 2.5 + scale 0.92, glow dims and shrinks; spring 700/40 in, 420/18 out
motion.menuOpen: plus rotates 135°, disc crossfades to milk, scrim fades in, content scales to 0.965, items stagger 50ms on spring 400/25 from scale 0.35
motion.numbers: later changes (a logged run) tween from the previous value over 640ms with a half blur
motion.badge: digits roll 11pt over 280ms, one tick to 1.22 on arrival; clears 650ms after opening Club
motion.ambient: a kudo arrives every 6.5s (max three) while another tab is open
motion.reducedMotion: entrances become 150ms fades, numbers and charts appear at their values, no springs, stretch or ambient badge
motion.entrance: per tab, on every visit: blocks in reading order fade in, rise 12pt and clear an 8px blur over 520ms ease-out, 55ms apart (rows 45ms); iOS settles from scale 0.98 instead of blur
motion.figures: 150ms after their block: numbers count up from 0 over 680ms with a 5px blur settling; lines, routes and rings draw via strokeDashoffset (680–800ms); sparkline areas fade in behind the stroke; bars grow from the baseline with a 30ms stagger; dots and avatars pop last (spring 400/28, one overshoot)
motion.progress: progress bars fill 300ms after their block lands, over 520ms; whole sequence under ~900ms
motion.tabSwitch: old view fades, lifts 6pt and blurs out over 130ms ease-in, then the new view remounts and replays its entrance; a tap mid-exit only retargets
motion.barEntrance: bar and centre action rise 36pt on spring 260/28 at first view

responsive.width: 360–430pt; slots are measured with onLayout so the lens and arc scale with the bar; route rows narrow their elevation chart under 380pt

accessibility: Tabs use accessibilityRole tab with selected state and a label that includes the badge count
Centre action is a button with an expanded state and a label that flips between open and close
The scrim is a labelled close button
The toast is a polite live region
Charts carry text labels (daily distances, streak)

content.week: 32.4 of 40 km; M 6.2, T 12.0, W 6.1, T 8.1 (today), F–S planned
screens: Routes: Hackney Marshes loop + 4 saved routes
Club: Hackney Harriers goal, kudos, leaderboard

avoid: Decorative colour: gradient hero cards, tinted washes, coloured avatars, rainbow tiles
A second accent competing with the one accent
A flat translucent grey bar with no real blur
Opacity animations on the BlurView's ancestors
Icon fonts, icon packs or emoji
Tab content that pops in unanimated, or a 'lighter' unfinished screen
An indicator that jumps or wobbles
More than one bounce on anything
